name: Xero
summary: Xero has no approval queue to wait on; what you pick is a paid tier by connection count (free up to 5). Check the developer terms before using the data with AI.

toggles.label: How many Xero organisations will connect?

gates.title: Create an app in the Xero developer portal
Subscribe to the Core or Plus tier

blockers.symptom: Connections stop at the tier maximum
blockers.fix: Move up a tier; connections are capped until you meet that tier's requirements.

gates.title: Accept the developer terms (no AI training, no bots simulating users)

blockers.symptom: Your use case trains AI/ML models on API data or simulates user actions
blockers.fix: That use is banned by the new terms; redesign it or ask Xero.

requirements.label: Payment method on the Xero developer account
howToGet: Add a card to your Xero developer account

claims.text: From 2 Mar 2026: Starter 5 connections free; Core 50 A$35/mo; Plus 1,000 A$245/mo; Advanced 10,000 A$1,445/mo; Enterprise by arrangement. A payment method is needed from Core.

sources.quote: Starter 5 conns free · Core 50 A$35/mo · Plus 1,000 A$245 · Advanced 10,000 A$1,445 · Enterprise POA.

claims.text: Connections are capped at the tier maximums until you meet that tier's requirements.
